text:
Maya Bhandari: Heads up — we have a customer reporting a sudden p99 latency spike on chat-api in us-west-2. p95 went from ~110ms to ~470ms, p99 ~1.9s. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/rum/customer/alpha-inc
Liam Chen: seen it on the global latency dashboard too. looks correlated with kernel selection changes from last deploy (compileflag: ATTN_OPT_LEVEL=2)
Maya Bhandari: timeline — deploy at 07:12 UTC applied new heuristics that prefer SDPA for medium-length sequences. spike starts ~07:15.
George Ortiz: digging into traces — many requests show fallback churn: SDPA kernel compiled path -> fallback to generic attn -> retry. that explains the tail.
Priya Rao: can you paste a sample trace id? I want to check KV cache hot paths + batch sizes.
George Ortiz: trace: trace-0a1b2c, snippet: "kernel_select: sdpa_attempt -> compile_miss -> gemm_fallback -> slow_path". Also see repeated compile invocations for same model version.
Maya Bhandari: customer repro steps: small chat messages with seq_len 512, bursty concurrency ~200 qps for short bursts. They were pinned to model v2.3.0.
support-oncall: I opened a high-priority support case and pinged the customer for a canary window. they can reproduce repeatedly.
Liam Chen: quick mitigation options:
- force SDPA off for v2.3.0 (route to flash-off kernel policy)
- revert ATT N_OPT_LEVEL compile flag to 1
- pin affected nodes to compiled kernel cache
Which is fastest to rollback?
Priya Rao: forcing SDPA off via route policy is fastest and non-disruptive. rollback compile flags requires fleet restart.
infra-bot: Runbook suggestion: `admin control set-kernel-policy --model v2.3.0 --prefer sdpa=false --force=true` (dry-run available)
Maya Bhandari: let's do force-off on subset (10% for canary) and observe p99 over 10 minutes, then 100% if stable.
Liam Chen: executing canary now: `admin control set-kernel-policy --model v2.3.0 --prefer sdpa=false --percent 10`
infra-bot: Action accepted. canary rollout started. tracking /metrics/chat-api/latency?filter=model:v2.3.0
George Ortiz: first 3 mins look promising — p99 down to ~420ms in canary shard. non-canary still high.
Priya Rao: customers on canary reporting improvements. recommending escalate to 50% if next 10m stable.
Liam Chen: increasing to 50%: `admin control set-kernel-policy --model v2.3.0 --prefer sdpa=false --percent 50`
Maya Bhandari: also add temporary compile-cache pin: `runtime-admin pin-compile-cache --model v2.3.0 --node-group g-west-1 --ttl 2h` to avoid on-the-fly compiles while we evaluate.
George Ortiz: noted. while canary progressed we also saw compile flag causing extra JIT overhead on older GPUs (driver v510). might need driver matrix exclusion later.
support-oncall: Customer confirmed improvement in their load tests on canary. I'll coordinate moving them fully to the canary shards.
Priya Rao: longer-term: revert ATT N_OPT_LEVEL=2 until we have regression tests for medium sequence SDPA fallbacks. also add a gating perf-eval that simulates bursty 200 qps loads with seq_len distribution.
Liam Chen: opening a postmortem ticket and assigning kernel-selection owners. action items:
- Maya: coordinate full rollback / percent -> 100% (if 50% stable) (owner)
- George: root cause writeup + compile cache telemetry improvements (owner)
- Priya: perf-eval + test harness for bursty seq_len patterns (owner)
- Infra: add driver/version exclusion matrix to release checklist (owner)
Maya Bhandari: agreed. I'll escalate release freeze on ATT N_OPT_LEVEL=2 and schedule a rollback if 50% remains stable for 15m.
infra-bot: Canary reached 100% at 07:41 UTC. system note: kernel policy change applied to 42 nodes.
George Ortiz: final numbers after full rollout: p95 ~120ms, p99 ~430ms — back to acceptable range. will monitor for 2h then close support case.
support-oncall: closing loop with customer and sending summary. thanks all :heart:
Priya Rao: follow-up: add a pre-check in compiler pipeline to avoid triggering SDPA compile for GPUs with older drivers or low compile-cache hit rate.
Maya Bhandari: thanks team. I'll draft the incident summary and link the perf graphs + trace ids to the postmortem.
Liam Chen: thumbs up. recreate repro in staging with pinned driver v510 to validate future fixes.
infra-bot: Incident tag created: INC-2026-2241. Skip-trace links: https://dash.redwood/traces/trace-0a1b2c
Maya Bhandari: end of thread — moving items to the eng-runtime board.
